title: Templars and the secrets of time travel

tellings.quote: Templars supposedly had the secrets of time travel you know if you read the Umberto eeko Fuko pendulum

plain: The Knights Templar, the medieval order of crusader knights, supposedly held the secrets of time travel, Michels says in passing. He offers it himself and points not to a historical source but to Foucault's Pendulum, a novel by the Italian writer Umberto Eco.
